children: A series of polls on Saturday showed Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva about even before Sunday's runoff vote, with the right-wing lawmaker still favored to win after finishing ahead of the leftist incumbent in the first round.
MDA surveyed 2,032 people from October 21 to October 23; margin of error of 2.2 percentage points
Datafolha surveyed 4,050 people from October 23-24; margin of error of 2 percentage points
Quaest surveyed 3,702 people from October 23-24; margin of error of 2 percentage points
AtlasIntel surveyed 4,990 people from October 18 to October 23; margin of error of 1 percentage point
Nexus surveyed 2,000 people from October 23-24; margin of error of 2.2 percentage points

title: Bolsonaro, Lula about even in polls for Brazil runoff vote
